tasks.title: Nmap RPC Scripts
tasks.description: Portmapper on 111 itself rarely matters, but it tells you which RPC-registered services (NFS, NIS, rpc.statd) are actually running and on what port.

tasks.title: Confirm NFS Registration
tasks.description: If 'nfs' or 'mountd' shows up in the rpcinfo output, move straight to the NFS methodology (port 2049) to enumerate and mount exports.
